home.feedDescription: Connected data source to quickly validate Supabase integration during development.

login.description: Manage sales, inventory, and customers in minutes with zero hassle.
login.brandSlogan: Your entire business, on one platform.
login.heroDescription: Vex turns your daily operation into measurable results: quote faster, control inventory in real time, and make clearer decisions to sell better from day one.

register.brandSlogan: Your entire business, on one platform.

onboarding.headline: Let’s begin
onboarding.title: Complete your company setup
onboarding.description: Choose your plan and confirm the minimum tenant data to unlock the dashboard and operations modules.
onboarding.descriptionCompact: Choose the plan that best matches your current operation, review included capabilities, and get your account ready to launch with real business context.
onboarding.onboardingCompleted: Initial setup completed. You can continue to the dashboard.

free.name: Free
free.summary: Great for getting started with a small team. It includes the core sales and inventory flow with clear limits so you can validate your operation and scale with structure.

premium.name: Premium
premium.summary: Built for growing businesses that need faster operations, more concurrent users, and broader traceability without additional complexity.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.summary: Designed for complex operations that require advanced security, higher scalability, and specialized support across multiple teams.

productsLimit.label: Products
productsLimit.description: Maximum number of active products you can manage.

usersLimit.label: Users
usersLimit.description: Team members with operational access to the platform.

warehousesLimit.label: Warehouses
warehousesLimit.description: Storage locations available to control your inventory.

reports.label: Advanced reports
reports.description: Dashboards and reports to analyze sales and inventory performance.

support.label: Support
support.description: Level of operational assistance available for your team.

sso.label: Enterprise SSO
sso.description: Single sign-on with your corporate identity provider.

onboarding.billingPermissionRequired: Your current role does not have billing permissions to change the plan.

plans.title: Choose your subscription type
plans.description: Each plan unlocks different capabilities to run your business.
plans.descriptionCompact: Compare capabilities, limits, and support level to pick the right plan for your current growth stage.

nextSteps.title: What comes next
nextSteps.description: After completing onboarding, open the dashboard and start with products, customers, inventory and sales according to your plan.

checkout.title: Confirm your plan
checkout.description: Review your selected plan details before proceeding to payment.
checkout.secureNote: Your payment will be processed securely.
checkout.simulatedNote: This is a test environment. No real charge will be made.

welcome.title: Your account is now active
welcome.description: Your plan has been successfully activated. We will now walk you through the key features of the platform so you can start operating right away.
welcome.skipTutorial: Skip tutorial and go to dashboard

tutorial.title: Discover the platform
tutorial.description: Review the modules available in your plan before you start operating.

dashboard.title: Operational dashboard
dashboard.description: The dashboard gives you immediate visibility into revenue, inventory stock alerts, active quotes, and recent sales — all in one view so you can make decisions without hunting for data across multiple screens.

products.title: Product catalogue
products.description: Create and organise your catalogue with prices, units of measure, and references. Each product is linked to your inventory so stock is updated automatically with every movement.

customers.title: Customers and sales pipeline
customers.description: Register customers with their contact and tax details. From here you can create quotes and track the sales history per customer to measure the commercial relationship.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.description: Generate professional quotes in seconds, add products from the catalogue, and send them directly to the customer. When the customer accepts, the quote converts to a sale with a single click.

dashboard.title: Business dashboard
dashboard.description: Domain modules already present in server, ready to consume from UI or API.
dashboard.descriptionModern: Track inventory, sales, products and quotes from a cleaner operational workspace.
dashboard.weeklyRevenueDescription: Daily sales behavior across the current operating window.
dashboard.periodRevenueDescription: Sales comparison for the selected time range.
dashboard.quotePipelineDescription: Current distribution of the commercial funnel by status.
dashboard.recentSalesDescription: Latest orders recorded for operational follow-up.
dashboard.moduleCardDescription: Quick visual status and trend for this module.
dashboard.noSalesInRange: No sales were recorded in the selected range.
